# GitLab Fleet Governor - Comprehensive LLM Specification & Context Document

Version: 1.0.0
Author: Divmora Team
Repository: https://github.com/divmora/gitlab-fleet-governor

---

## 1. System Overview

GitLab Fleet Governor (`gitlab-fleet-governor`) is a production-grade, declarative policy-as-code and governance automation engine implemented in Go. It operates idempotently across enterprise GitLab topologies (spanning thousands of groups and repositories).

### Architectural Philosophy
1. Declarative Invariant Convergence: Converges GitLab fleet state to desired state defined in YAML or JSON policies.
2. Simulation Before Mutation (Dry-Run First): Default mode is non-destructive dry-run preview.
3. Transport Resilience & Rate Politeness: Proactive token-bucket rate limiting (default 30 RPS, 50 burst) and exponential backoff retry with jitter on HTTP 429 and 5xx.
4. Zero-Trust Credential Masking: Secrets and variables are masked in all logs and reports.

---

## 2. CLI Command Line Interface

```bash
# General Syntax
gitlab-fleet-governor [command] [flags]

# Commands
gitlab-fleet-governor run -c <path> [flags]        # Execute fleet governance
gitlab-fleet-governor validate -c <path> [flags]   # Validate policy syntax & schema offline
gitlab-fleet-governor lambda --event <path>        # Emulate local AWS Lambda execution
gitlab-fleet-governor version                      # Show build & semver information

# Global Flags
-c, --config string        # Path to config file, or '-' for stdin
--dry-run                  # Simulate mutations without modifying remote state (default: true)
--concurrency int          # Number of concurrent worker goroutines (default: 10)
--log-level string         # "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error" (default: "info")
--log-format string        # "text" | "json" (default: "text")
--report-format string     # "table" | "summary" | "json" | "csv" | "markdown" (default: "table")
-o, --output string        # Output file destination for summary reports
```

---

## 3. Complete YAML / JSON Schema Reference

```yaml
version: "v1"

settings:
  dry_run: true
  concurrency: 10
  log_level: "info"
  log_format: "text"
  report_format: "table"
  gitlab:
    base_url: "${GITLAB_BASE_URL:-https://gitlab.com}"
    token: "${GITLAB_TOKEN}"
    rate_limit_rps: 30.0
    rate_limit_burst: 50
    max_retries: 3
    retry_base_delay_ms: 500

targets:
  group_selector:
    group_ids_include: [101, 202]
    group_ids_exclude: [999]
    group_paths_include: ["enterprise/core", "payments"]
    group_paths_exclude: ["enterprise/archived"]
    recursive: true
  project_selector:
    namespaces_include: ["payments"]
    namespaces_exclude: ["payments/deprecated"]
    project_name_regex_include: "^svc-.*$"
    project_name_regex_exclude: "^.*-spike$"
    visibility: "all" # "public" | "internal" | "private" | "all"
    archived: false
    id_range:
      min: 1
      max: 50000

policies:
  # 1. Push Rules (Project & Group Level)
  push_rules:
    author_email_regex: "@fleetcorp\\.io$"
    branch_name_regex: "^(main|develop|feat/.*)$"
    commit_message_regex: "^(feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore)(\\(.+\\))?:.+"
    file_name_regex: "(?i)\\.(pem|key|pkcs12|id_rsa)$"
    max_file_size: 25 # MB
    prevent_secrets: true
    reject_unsigned_commits: true
    commit_committer_check: true
    member_check: true
    deny_delete_tag: true

  # 2. Protected Branches (Project Level)
  protected_branches:
    - name: "main"
      allowed_to_push:
        - access_level: 0 # 0=No Access, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 60=Admin
      allowed_to_merge:
        - access_level: 40
      allowed_to_unprotect:
        - access_level: 40
      allow_force_push: false
      code_owner_approval_required: true

  # 3. Merge Request Approval Rules (Project Level)
  approval_rules:
    settings:
      allow_author_approval: false
      allow_committer_approval: false
      allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request: false
      retain_approvals_on_push: true
    rules:
      - name: "AppSec Approval Rule"
        approvals_required: 1
        user_usernames:
          - "security-auditor"
        protected_branch_names:
          - "main"

  # 4. Project Settings (Project Level)
  project_settings:
    default_branch: "main"
    squash_option: "always" # "always" | "never" | "default_on" | "default_off"
    merge_method: "rebase_merge" # "merge" | "rebase_merge" | "ff"
    only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds: true
    only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_resolved: true
    keep_latest_artifact: true
    printing_merge_request_link_enabled: true

  # 5. Pipeline Retention (Project Level)
  pipeline_retention:
    retention_days: 30 # Converted automatically to native ci_delete_pipelines_in_seconds

  # 6. CI/CD Variables (Project & Group Level)
  variables:
    - key: "GLOBAL_API_ENDPOINT"
      value: "https://api.fleetcorp.io/v1"
      variable_type: "env_var" # "env_var" | "file"
      protected: true
      masked: false
      raw: true
      environment_scope: "*"

  # 7. Project & Group Runners
  runners:
    - id: 1
      paused: false
      locked: true
      tag_list:
        - "docker"
        - "linux-amd64"
      access_level: "not_protected" # "not_protected" | "ref_protected"

  # 8. Compliance Framework (Project Level)
  compliance:
    framework_name: "SOC2"
    prune: false

  # 9. Webhooks (Project Level)
  webhooks:
    - url: "https://events.fleetcorp.io/audit"
      push_events: true
      merge_requests_events: true
      enable_ssl_verification: true
      secret_token: "${AUDIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET}"

  # 10. Members Governance (Audit Mode)
  members:
    max_access_level: 40
    enforce_expires_at: true
    max_expiration_days: 90
    denied_members:
      - "compromised-user"
    allowed_members:
      - username: "security-lead"
        access_level: 40
```

---

## 4. GitLab Access Levels

| Access Level | Role |
|---|---|
| `0` | No Access |
| `5` | Minimal Access |
| `10` | Guest |
| `20` | Reporter |
| `30` | Developer |
| `40` | Maintainer |
| `50` | Owner |
| `60` | Admin |
